text_block_list.text:
As part of the Fan Meet-and-Greet, Win 
Variation, who has ballet experience, was 
set to take the stage—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: One, two...! One, two...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Ah, I'm good. We double-checked 
it during rehearsal..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm the headliner for today's event, after 
all. I'll do my best...!
choice_data_list: I'm glad. But aren't you feeling nervous?
I'm glad. But aren't you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...That's fine too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
We should probably get ready soon. I'm 
gonna go change...!

What could I do to ease Win Variation's 
nerves? Wondering that, I went to pick her 
up from the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —...All right.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. I'm all ready to go, ya know.

Win Variation's eyes shone with even 
greater determination than before. Seeing 
that spark, I suddenly remembered—

"That was back when we were discussing her 
racing silk design. We watched a DVD of a 
ballet where Win Variation's father played 
the lead role—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...It's gotta be this after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. For my racing outfit, I want 
ballet to be the motif!
choice_data_list: Are you keeping your father in mind?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Watching that footage just now made 
me think. —Yeah, this really is my origin.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day... I played the lead role 
in a ballet recital, and my mind went 
completely blank.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I lost sight of how I should properly act 
as the leading star on the big stage...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
From here on... even in the racing world, 
the immense pressure might cause me to 
lose sight of who I am.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still... the kind of protagonist I want 
to be is like my dad when I watched him as 
a kid.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm carving it into my 
racewear. The origin of my aspiration, to 
serve as a guide to return to.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Even when feeling crushed by the 
pressure, remember your ideal leading 
role, picture it..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: So that I will never hesitate again—...!

――...Win Variation right now has the exact 
same look in her eyes as back then.
choice_data_list:
(If anything, I find it kind of 
reassuring...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Time to head out, right? Let's go, 
Trainer!

Right before her cue. Waiting in the wings 
of the stage, Win Variation spent that 
time—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ――……*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm totally fired up. 'Cause right 
now, I can see it clearly!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A glorious stage, just like the one Dad 
stood upon back then—!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, let's welcome her to the 
stage! Win Variation, please come on up!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally time...! All right, I'm 
heading out!"
choice_data_list: Yeah... Do your best out there!
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally time...! All right, I'm 
heading out!"
choice_data_list: Yeah... Do your best out there!
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ……'Sup!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(......Today, I'm the star. So, I'm gonna 
show them all.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Appreciate the concern!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Still—...please watch me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(......Today, I'm the star. So, I'm gonna 
show them all.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I'll put on the best performance—one 
worthy of this outfit!)
(WAAAAAH...!!)

Cheers erupted from the stands at Win 
Variation's performance.
